name: spark-one-04-teacher-score-test
cmd: python3 -m spark_one.teacher.score --bank data/generated/bank --split val --primitives choice noul score --out runs/teacher/val.jsonl --model google/gemma-4-31B-it && python3 -m spark_one.teacher.score --bank data/generated/bank --split test --primitives choice noul score --out runs/teacher/test.jsonl --model google/gemma-4-31B-it && python3 -m spark_one.teacher.to_preds runs/teacher/val.jsonl runs/teacher/val_preds.jsonl && python3 -m spark_one.teacher.to_preds runs/teacher/test.jsonl runs/teacher/test_preds.jsonl && python3 -m spark_one.calibrate --bank data/generated/bank --preds runs/teacher/val_preds.jsonl --out runs/teacher/temps.json && python3 -m spark_one.eval.harness --bank data/generated/bank --preds runs/teacher/test_preds.jsonl --temps runs/teacher/temps.json --out runs/teacher/eval --name 'Gemma 4 31B teacher'
